rules.title: Seven real combat participants
rules.requirement: Every one of guardian_dog, gray_wolf, fox, owl, male_lion, white_tiger and brown_bear retains an unlocked, usable species-specific attack. Scouting, warning, retrieval, hauling and other specialties are additional value; they cannot replace attack or turn fox/owl into support-only pets.

rules.title: Useful attack outcome
rules.requirement: Every species has at least one ordinary eligible-hostile scenario in which a valid attack inflicts real positive damage and helps the player. Cosmetic swipes, an unused animation, a statistics-only aura, a warning marker or merely being marked attack_allowed do not pass. Exact damage and cadence require balanced actor/target evidence.

rules.title: Complete attack state and contact
rules.requirement: Bind ready/approach/anticipation/commit/contact-or-miss/recovery/return, interruption and resume to the actual species rig. Each intentional contact group has an authoritative attack-instance/event identity; repeat overlap, extra claws, animation callbacks or reload cannot duplicate that group. An intentionally multi-hit attack must declare its separate groups. A miss, invalid target or cancellation before contact causes no damage.

rules.title: Legitimate targets and friendly identity
rules.requirement: Select and revalidate a living eligible hostile or explicitly authorized hunt target by stable identity, faction, current state and environment. Player, companions, workers, customers and rescue candidates are not ordinary hostile/loot targets. A hostile wolf or wildlife meat concept cannot supply a friendly-pet identity or drop policy. All pet kills use the shared exactly-once defeat/reward pipeline.

rules.title: Stable and readable priorities
rules.requirement: Preserve the simple-control and priority language of T07. Its frozen human-context selector does not automatically own animal behavior: species and T31 owners author pet/job arbitration, and any shared-selector change uses the existing authorized scope process. Recommended arbitration is: a current recall/retreat or safety constraint; an immediate threat to the assigned protected ally/area; an authorized player-selected reachable hostile; the assigned defense/hunt objective; then a safe opportunistic hostile. Keep a valid target until a meaningful priority/eligibility change; distribute useful engagement space instead of seven pets repeatedly switching to the nearest enemy.

rules.title: Physical range, pursuit and return
rules.requirement: Freeze sensed area, line-of-approach/occlusion, actual strike reach, safe route, pursuit leash, disengagement and return point for each profile. Damage must agree with visible contact, target size and obstructions. Do not teleport, clip through gates/walls, use omniscient targeting, chase indefinitely, or obtain a free attack through a sanctuary boundary. Failure to reach a target produces a truthful alternate/return state.

rules.title: Recall, preemption and useful resumption
rules.requirement: Recall prevents acquiring or extending a pursuit. Before a valid contact commit, a cancellable attack exits without damage; after a committed contact it exits at the authored safe boundary without repeating damage. Immediate defensive contact during withdrawal is permitted only when it does not countermand the return order. Store the suspended job and revalidate its target, reservation, destination, budget and cargo before resuming or choosing another useful job.

rules.title: Cargo and tools remain truthful
rules.requirement: A pet or survivor switching from carrying/working to combat first uses an authored compatible handling transition. A mouth/talon already holding cargo cannot silently keep that cargo while performing an incompatible bite/strike. Secure, hand off or explicitly set down typed owned cargo with recovery custody; never erase or duplicate it. A construction payment or machine transfer commits once or remains uncommitted.

rules.title: Coordinated attacks and fair rewards
rules.requirement: Use shared engagement-space/target state with bounded reservations and cleanup. Multiple allies may attack one durable enemy when appropriate, but contact validation, overkill, simultaneous defeat and reward generation stay authoritative. No repeated kill reward, friendly body-block trap, endless stun loop if control effects are selected, or camera-filling overlap. Defense structures and pets cooperate through the same target truths.

rules.title: Recoverable actor lifecycle
rules.requirement: Select explicit hurt, retreat, incapacitation-if-used, help/recovery and return-to-job rules shared with the loss/recovery decision. Recommended ordinary-play policy preserves named pet/survivor identity and progress, with free attainable recovery and no autonomous premium revive. The contract must expose what the player protects; invulnerable helpers and destructible helpers are different rules and must not be mixed accidentally.

rules.title: Progression and environment continuity
rules.requirement: Every species retains a real usable attack throughout applicable progression; this does not require each animal to fight in every region or terrain cell. Region owners bind safe deployment, reachable attacks, local target compatibility, transport, return and cargo continuity. An unsuitable environment may have an explicit inapplicable combat disposition with a useful safe alternative assignment and a retained combat role elsewhere in the progression. Use already selected compatible routes/staging or appropriate equipment only where it fits the region; do not invent new facilities/gear merely to fill a matrix, ordinary owl underwater flight, quadruped free flight or invisible remote damage. No silent conversion of a species to support-only and no mandatory paid environmental competence.

rules.title: Actual evidence, current standard
rules.requirement: Bind each species to the existing selected GitHub sheet and actual mesh/rig/profile/scene. Prove successful attack, miss, interrupted attack, target loss, recall, return-to-specialty and a later-region use case with exact-source full-cycle multi-angle playback and actual sound listening. Shared busy-scene/device evidence is additional. Historical 9.3/9.4 reference-sheet scores do not grant current approval; retain current reference >=9.9 and stronger exact-10 visual requirements.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Close escort and recovery of eligible light cargo.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: An enemy closes on an assigned carrier; the dog visibly lunges/bites, causes valid damage, then returns to escort without stealing the carried load.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Tracking and bounded pursuit of eligible threats or authorized prey.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Pursue an eligible hostile, pounce/bite with real contact, break off at the safe leash and return. Repeat with a friendly same-species actor present and prove identity separation.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Agile ground scouting and suitable light retrieval.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Dart into a legitimate opening, pounce/bite for meaningful damage and disengage. Demonstrate the attack during ordinary play; a fox that only fetches, warns or evades fails.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Aerial reconnaissance, warning and suitable light retrieval.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Take off, bank/anticipate, dive and strike with actual talon contact, recover in clear air and return/perch. A circling bird with a damage timer or a warning-only owl fails.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Defense of an exposed approach and protection of working allies.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Commit visibly to a charge/pounce/claw/bite against an eligible threat, apply authored contact damage and recover with believable mass. Keep mane, turning and ally clearance readable.
Use a reachable approach for a low ambush/pounce/claw/bite; no teleport flank. Show distinct timing/posture from the lion and return to its assigned objective.

species.additional_specialty_recommendation: Approved heavy hauling/obstacle work plus protection.
species.mandatory_combat_scenario: Secure an incompatible heavy load, charge/swipe/bite with weight-aware contact and damage, then reclaim or deliver conserved cargo. Slow mass must not stall the whole control loop.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Target and friendly identity
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Place friendly same-species actors, workers, customers, rescue candidates, eligible prey and hostiles together; only explicit legitimate targets can take attack damage or produce selected loot.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Recall at every attack phase
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Recall during approach, windup, contact and recovery; stop new pursuit, preserve committed damage once, return without target-thrashing and resume/reassign a valid useful job.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Geometry and boundary
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Use moving/small/large targets, occluded routes, a closing gate, sanctuary edge and vanished target; valid contact is visible and unreachable targets are safely abandoned.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Work interruption and cargo
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Interrupt heavy/mixed cargo, talon/mouth retrieval, cooking, rescue and a last plot payment; every unit and unspent budget remains accounted for through fight and return.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Shared defeat and recovery
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Player, pet and tower strike the last HP concurrently; persist one defeat/reward, reload and repeat around the commit boundary, with no duplicate loot/XP or lost valid result.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Roster switch and save
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Switch active pets with health/recovery/cargo/work/attack state and pause/reload/travel; preserve owned identity, no attack-reset exploit and no duplicated actor.

acceptance_scenarios.name: All human task families
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Run qualified survivors through all physical work families, every authorized plot type, substantial mixed loads and late-region jobs using minimal goals; no unexplained permanent specialization ban.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Actor recovery
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Apply the selected pet/survivor hurt/retreat/down/recovery rule while an escort/cargo/plot job is active; retain identity/entitlements and demonstrate attainable free recovery.

acceptance_scenarios.name: All region bands
